pattern: 中を / 中では（なかを / なかでは）
purpose: Place an action amid circumstances, or identify a comparison set.
keywords: Nの / plain clause + 中を; Nの + 中では
Thank you for coming despite being busy.
The athletes kept running in the rain.
Of these three books, this is the easiest to read.
formation: Nの / plain clause + 中を; Nの + 中では
restrictions: 中を often acknowledges difficult circumstances; 中では restricts comparison to a group.
mistake: These share 中 but have different roles; choose the particle for the intended relation.
